name: What information should I have ready before asking for a floor repair quote?

mainEntity.name: What information should I have ready before asking for a floor repair quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Photos help, but an on-site inspection is usually needed to confirm how far the damage goes. A good estimate should include the damaged room, flooring type, signs of moisture, and whether the repair is only cosmetic or structural.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have photos, approximate square footage, flooring type, and notes about leaks or soft spots ready. An in-person inspection is usually needed to confirm the full scope.
